settings.question: Tired of Pilates socks and yoga socks that slip?
settings.answer: Pilates socks, yoga socks, and barre grip socks fail at the dots — they peel, stretch, and force resets in chair pose and flat back chair. Barreletics Performance Skins are grippy shoes with 360° full-contact grip: not patches, not another disposable sock. Secure in Every Hold for barre, Pilates, yoga, reformer, Megaformer, Lagree, and hot studios.

settings.question: Are these good for reformer Pilates, Megaformer, Lagree & hot Pilates?
settings.answer: Yes — engineered for reformer carriage load, Megaformer, Lagree, barre, hot Pilates, and yoga. The 360° grip handles lateral forces that destroy traditional Pilates socks and yoga socks. Both perform identically with the same grip and stability.

settings.question: How long do they actually last?
settings.answer: Customers report 18+ months with daily studio use and zero grip degradation. The patented material doesn't wear down like silicone dots or rubber patches. One pair replaces 6–8 pairs of grip socks per year.

settings.question: How do I clean them?
settings.answer: Warm soapy water, rinse, air dry. Ready for your next class in under an hour. Never machine wash or bleach. The grip lasts indefinitely with proper care.

settings.question: What size should I order?
settings.answer: Available now: M (Women 5–7.5, Men 6–8) and L (Women 8–10, Men 8.5–11). The stretch-fit material conforms to your foot — if you're between sizes, go larger for the most comfortable fit.

settings.question: Closed Sole or Open Sole — which one?
settings.answer: Both perform identically with the same grip and stability. The difference is feel and coverage. Closed Sole: heel and foot fully covered. Open Sole: heel exposed, mid-foot breathing hole. More grounded, barefoot feel. Natural toe splay. Choice is preference and feel only.

settings.question: What's the return and warranty policy?
settings.answer: 30-day returns on items in new, sellable condition — try on for fit at home. 90-day warranty covers manufacturing defects only. Free shipping on orders over $150. We ship within 1–2 business days.

settings.question: Grippy shoes for barre, Pilates & yoga studios in New York City
settings.answer: Barreletics Studio Performance Skin is the preferred grip footwear at barre, Pilates, and reformer studios across Manhattan, Brooklyn, and the greater NYC area. Designed for the demands of New York's top-tier class schedules — from boutique Lagree rooms to classical Pilates studios — the 360° grip surface handles every surface, every transition, and every instructor's pace.

settings.question: Best grip shoes for reformer Pilates in Los Angeles
settings.answer: LA's reformer and Megaformer community has adopted Barreletics as the performance standard. From Santa Monica to West Hollywood studios, instructors trust the patented grip system that never degrades — even in high-heat rooms. No silicone, no latex, no compromises.

settings.question: Premium Pilates grip shoes — London & Melbourne studios
settings.answer: Barreletics ships internationally to Pilates and barre studios across London, Melbourne, Toronto, and Sydney. The same 360° grip trusted by 1,000+ instructors in the US, now available with international shipping. Built for reformer, Classical Pilates, and contemporary mat work.

settings.question: Grip shoes for Megaformer & Lagree fitness
settings.answer: Megaformer and Lagree demand lateral stability that grip socks cannot provide. Barreletics Performance Skin wraps the entire underfoot with continuous grip — eliminating the slip risk during lunges, pikes, and carriage work. Trusted by Lagree-certified instructors across North America.

settings.question: Best grip footwear for barre classes — Toronto & Canada
settings.answer: Canadian barre and Pilates studios choose Barreletics for the same reason US studios do: consistent 360° grip that outlasts every sock on the market. Available in both Open Sole and Closed Sole builds, shipping across Canada with standard and express options.

settings.question: Barreletics for hot yoga & heated studios
settings.answer: The patented grip surface performs better when warm — unlike silicone dots that degrade with heat and moisture. Hot yoga practitioners report improved traction during sweaty flows. No sliding, no bunching, no distraction from your practice.

settings.question: Grip shoes vs Pilates socks & yoga socks — which is better?
settings.answer: Pilates socks and yoga socks rely on silicone dots that wear off in weeks. Barreletics uses full-contact grip across the underfoot — one pair replaces the endless barre grip sock cycle. Consistent traction in chair pose, footwork, water ski, and heated rooms from day one.
